items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Because we signed with Cotique with George Goldner and then he was a good marketing man.

ctx.x: All right. Then what prompted you to record that bugaloo album for Cotique?
Because we signed with Cotique with George Goldner and then he was a good marketing man. He had that knack that he know what the people would like.
Did that album do anything for the band?
